def test_flip_case():
    # Basic mixed case
    assert flip_case("Hello World") == "hELLO wORLD"
    # All lowercase
    assert flip_case("abc") == "ABC"
    # All uppercase
    assert flip_case("ABC") == "abc"
    # Empty string
    assert flip_case("") == ""
    # No letters (digits/punctuation unchanged)
    assert flip_case("123 !@#") == "123 !@#"
    # Single character
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    # Already flipped round-trips back
    assert flip_case(flip_case("PyThOn 3.12")) == "PyThOn 3.12"
